profile.name: IMS电机轴
profile.description: 一种用于实验室和光束线装置中的电动运动轴，通常驱动直线或旋转定位机构，对样品、光学元件或诊断部件进行精密位置调整。该类电机支持回零、限位管理、状态监测和故障清除，适合需要可靠重复定位的实验场景。
profile.description_en: A motorized motion axis used in laboratory and beamline systems to drive linear or rotary positioning mechanisms for precise adjustment of samples, optics, or diagnostics. This type of motor supports homing, limit management, status monitoring, and fault clearing, making it suitable for experiments that require reliable repeatable positioning.

registry.name: IMS Integrated Motion
